```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(haven)
```


## Read in some data
Import litters csv file data set using relative path:

```{r loading dataset with absolute path}
litters_df = read_csv(file = "./data/FAS_litters.csv")
```
Clean the variable names using janitor::clean_names()
```{r snake text variable naming}
litters_df = janitor::clean_names(litters_df)
names(litters_df)
```
## Take a look at the data

Printing in the console
```{r}
litters_df
```

Summarizes the data briefly
```{r}
skimr::skim(litters_df)
```
## Options to read_csv

```{r}
litters_df= read_csv("./data/FAS_litters.csv")

```
use skip= # to skip the first however many rows
use na= ".", "NA", "999" to identify missing values
use col_names= FALSE to tell R that the first column is not name of variable

## Other file formats
Read in an excel file 

```{r}
mlb_df = read_excel("./data/mlb11.xlsx")
mlb_df
```
Read in a SAS file
```{r}
pulse_df = read_sas("./data/public_pulse_data.sas7bdat")
pulse_df
```
## Comparison with Base R

What about `read.csv` vs. `read_csv`...???
always use `read_csv` !!!

```{r}
litters_base = read.csv("./data/FAS_litters.csv")
litters_readr= read_csv("./data/FAS_litters.csv")

litters_base
litters_readr
```
## Exporting data

Export the mlb sub-table. 
```{r}
mlb_sub= read_excel("./data/mlb11.xlsx", range = "A1:F7")
mlb_sub
```

```{r}
write_csv(mlb_sub, "./data/mlb_subtable.csv")
```


## Additional Practice
Load the FAS_pups data set using relative path and clean variable name:
```{r loading dataset with relative path}
pups_df= read_csv(file = "./data/FAS_pups.csv")
```


Address missing values:., NA, and blank cells will be treated as missing values. 
```{r}
litters_df= read_csv(
  file = "./data/FAS_litters.csv", 
  na= c(".", "NA", ""))
```

Explicitly give column specifications of variable type:
```{r}
litters_df= 
  read_csv(file= "./data/FAS_litters.csv",
                     na= c(".", "NA", ""),
                     col_types = cols(
                       Group= col_character(),
                       `Litter Number`= col_character(),
                       `GD0 weight`= col_double(),
                       `GD18 weight`= col_double(),
                       `GD of Birth`= col_integer(),
                       `Pups born alive`= col_integer(),
                       `Pups dead @ birth`= col_integer(),
                       `Pups survive`= col_integer()
                     )
           )
```


# Section 3: Pups Dataframe

View Data
```{r}
skimr::skim(pups_df)
```
rename variables and address missingness
```{r}
pups_df= read_csv("./data/FAS_pups.csv",
                  skip=3,
                  na= c(".", "NA", "")
                  )
```

categroizing variables:
```{r}
pups_df= 
  read_csv(file= "./data/FAS_pups.csv", 
           skip=3,
           na= c(".", "NA", ""),
                  col_types = cols(
                    Sex= col_character(),
                    `PD ears`= col_character(),
                    `PD eyes`= col_character(),
                    `PD pivot`= col_character(),
                    `PD walk`= col_character()
                  ))
```
